transcription: FAKE TEST ROW. Snow leopards live high in the mountains of Central Asia. Their thick fur and long tail keep them warm, and wide paws work like snowshoes.
FAKE TEST ROW. Gorillas live in family groups led by a silverback male. They eat leaves, stems and fruit, and build a new nest to sleep in every night.
FAKE TEST ROW. The red panda spends most of its life in trees and eats mainly bamboo. Despite its name it is not closely related to the giant panda.
